newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds fall with Bunds on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds fall with Bunds on technicals.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds moved sharply lower on Monday as German Bunds broke through technical support levels and the dollar eased, but traders said there was no fundamental reason for the decline.
"Some technical levels were broken in Bunds and the dollar was weaker," one trader said. "But I can see no other reason for the move."

Traders said they expected the OLO market to continue tracking its German neighbour in coming days with players keeping a weather eye on German M3 data that is due later in the week and on U.S. inflation figures due on Wednesday.
Traders said there had been a certain amount of price movement in Belgium, but no great volume of actual business.
The yield of the benchmark 2007 OLO ended Monday at 5.95 percent against Friday's closing 5.82, and the spread over Bunds edged one basis point narrower to 10 bps.
The March futures contract was 81 basis points down at the day's low of 120.99, having opened at 121.87.
